collectible.title: Pilot ID
collectible.subtitle: For scanning delivery orders through the Regisystem.
collectible.text:
ジュラ・ベーシル・エルデン
Jura Basil Elden
Rank: Pilot
Age: 20
Blood Type: AB
Birthday: August 31st
Height: 174 cm
Weight: 53 kg
B-W-H: 93-60-91 cm
Voice: Yuu Asakawa

Pilots a special scarlet Dread fighter, as well as the crab-like "Red Claw" Vandread mech, known for its shielding capabilities. Her Dread has been modified by their Paksis core, so it no longer fits in the platforms for standard orders. Jura was already a senior pilot when Barnette joined and started working in Reg; they first met when Barnette critiqued her loadout.
collectible.unlock: Guide Jura's Preset Table through some Growing Pains.

collectible.title: Pilot ID (Barnette)
collectible.subtitle: For scanning, and fulfilling, delivery orders through the Regisystem.
collectible.text:
バーネット・オランジェロ
Barnette Orangello
Rank: Pilot/Regisystem Manager
Age: 19
Blood Type: A
Birthday: October 4th
Height: 163 cm
Weight: 49 kg
B-W-H: 87-58-89 cm
Voice: Michiko Neya

Pilots a standard pink Dread. Unlike Meia and Jura, her Dread was not transformed by the Paksis Pragma, and thus cannot combine with a Vanguard. Prefers aggressive bombardment loadouts and even tried to order a kamikaze set on one occasion. Now serves as Chief and Weapons Shop Owner of the Regisystem, piloting its armored delivery ship and managing orders, munitions, and security.
collectible.unlock: Give Barnette a promotion---and a new outfit.

collectible.title: Jura's Kisses

collectible.text:
"Mmmmwah!"

You feel her lipstick smear and her breasts squish. She's wrapped her naked body around you. You think that's it, but she goes in for a dozen more.

"Mwah! Mwah! Mwah! I'm thanking you properly. You taught Jura so much! I'll---mwahmnn---have to come back one day..."
collectible.unlock: Make Jura lose as a male.

collectible.title: CZ 75
collectible.subtitle: "We're not going to Moscow. It's Czechoslovakia! It's like going into Wisconsin."
collectible.text:
Type: Semiautomatic
Manufacturer: ČZUB
Designed: 1975
Cartridge: 9x19 mm Parabellum
Walnut Grip
Original "Short-Rail" Model

Of the many 20th-century antiques in Barnette's collection, the CZ 75 handgun is her favorite, and her sidearm of choice. Also among its fans is Chicago gunshop owner Irene "Rally" Vincent of Gunsmith Cats, another character voiced by Michiko Neya. No surprise: Takeshi Mori directed both series.
collectible.unlock: Make Jura lose as a female.

collectible.title: MAC-10
collectible.subtitle: "Fit only for combat in a phone booth."
collectible.text:
Type: Machine pistol/Submachine gun
Manufacturer: Military Armament Corporation
Designed: 1964
Cartridge: .45 ACP, 9x19 mm Parabellum
Telescoping Bolt
Blowback-operated

Once banned in the 20th century, this compact antique found its way to Mejare in Barnette's collection. The "M10" was famous for its two-stage suppressor, giving you ample peace and quiet to take in the Christmas cheer. Barnette, meanwhile, would fire missiles from it if she could.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Santa Jura.

collectible.title: Smith & Wesson Model 29
collectible.subtitle: "'Do I feel lucky?' Well, do ya, perv?"
collectible.text:
Type: Revolver
Manufacturer: Smith & Wesson
Designed: 1955
Cartridge: .44 Magnum
Six-shot, Double-action
4-inch Barrel

Once known as "the most powerful handgun in the world," the Model 29 introduced the .44 Magnum cartridge and was intended for hunters of large, dangerous game---perhaps even the most dangerous game. Also known for its "open, adjustable rear"---much like its owner.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Jura: White-Hot.

collectible.title: Colt Commando XM177
collectible.subtitle: "This is how real combat's supposed to be!"
collectible.text:
Type: Select-fire
Manufacturer: Colt Defense
Designed: 1966
Cartridge: .223 Remington
Unique Flash/Sound Suppressor
AKA the Model 610

When Barnette expects to encounter some close-quarters combat, she's all too happy to bust out the big stuff. The Colt Commando XM177 is one among a family of assault rifles based on the M16, in turn adapted from the AR-15. Contemporary jungle-warfare reliability issues are less of a concern in outer space---and if all else fails, she brought extras.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Jura: Luxury Night.
